description: List the bundled US medical code systems with their release identifiers, effective dates, and code counts, and the RxClass drug-class layer the class crosswalks read, with each source’s version. Confirms which ICD-10-CM fiscal year, ICD-10-PCS fiscal year, HCPCS Level II release, RxNorm normalized set, and RxClass sources are active before acting on any decode, search, or crosswalk result. The corpus is offline and built at package-build time — this call reports exactly which release is baked into the running server. ICD-10-CM/PCS are the US clinical modifications, not the ICD-10/ICD-11 base.
name: medcode_list_systems

classCount.description: RxClass class nodes bundled, including hierarchy nodes with no direct member.

edgeCount.description: Drug–class edges bundled, across every source.

sourceUrl.description: The RxClass API the layer was fetched from.

sources.description: One entry per bundled RxClass source.

items.description: Provenance for one bundled RxClass source.

classCount.description: Classes this source asserts at least one bundled edge to.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 date the RxClass snapshot was fetched — how current the class edges are.

source.description: The RxClass source, as class hits carry it in `source`: MEDRT, FDASPL, FMTSME, VA, RXNORM (DEA schedules), or CDC (CVX).

version.description: The release RxClass reports for this source, or null when it publishes none.

classLayer.description: The RxClass drug-class layer the rxcui_to_classes and class_to_rxcuis directions of medcode_map_codes read — not a code system, so it has no entry in `systems`. Null when this build carries no class layer.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

systems.description: One entry per bundled code system, in canonical order — the systems the `system` inputs of the other tools accept.

items.description: Provenance for one bundled code system.

builtAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this system’s data. For ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and HCPCS, the time the index was built from the release named in `releaseId`. For RxNorm, which publishes no release label, the date the RxNav snapshot was fetched — how current its drug data is, unchanged by a rebuild from the same snapshot.

codeCount.description: Number of code rows bundled for this system.

effectiveEnd.description: Last date this release is effective (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if open-ended.

effectiveStart.description: First date this release is effective (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not recorded.

releaseId.description: Release/version identifier baked into this build, e.g. "ICD-10-CM FY2026".

sourceUrl.description: Canonical .gov source the release was built from, or null.

title: List Code Systems
